one_line: New AI models from Anthropic and Meta launch alongside major hardware updates, corporate mergers, and semiconductor security investigations.

themes.title: Labs release new models and hardware
themes.text: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models, Meta introduced its lightweight reasoning model Muse Ember, and Google announced eighth-generation TPU systems.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 models
Meta releases Muse Ember lightweight reasoning model
Google expands TPU family with TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems
Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models

themes.title: Companies announce partnerships and infrastructure plans
themes.text: Ada and Dialpad merged their customer service software businesses, Disney and Adobe partnered on generative AI models, and SpaceX and Mavria advanced infrastructure and data center plans.

stories.headline: Ada and Dialpad merge to combine AI customer service software
Disney and Adobe partner to build proprietary generative AI models
SpaceX plans $24B gas power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, TX
ByteDance considers data center expansion in Ceará, Brazil
Former US DOE staffers launch modular data center firm Mavria with $130M

themes.title: Nvidia investigates CEO and chip diversion
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, while a chip smuggling probe involving Megaspeed moved to the Justice Department.

stories.headline: Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy
Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged spy
Nvidia intervention leads to Commerce chip smuggling probe being moved to DOJ

themes.title: Regulators and firms address AI safety
themes.text: The European Commission considered the Digital Fairness Act targeting addictive AI relationships, while Fireworks disclosed a cyberattack exposing customer datasets and model weights.

stories.headline:

relationships
